subject: ophthalmology
title: Gonioscopy and Angle Assessment

steps.tx: **Gonioscopy** views anterior chamber angle through contact mirror lens overcoming corneal total internal reflection, grading openness and identifying synechiae, recession, neovascularisation and pigment. It classifies every glaucoma mechanism and is mandatory before laser or surgery selection. Dark room and narrow beam avoid pupil constriction falsely opening angle during assessment.
steps.say: Mirror viewing together gives angle classification in every glaucoma at diagnosis clinics for adults without exception. Technique conditions gives validity additionally. Mechanism gives laser direction.

steps.tx: Angle structures from anterior to posterior are Schwalbe line, trabecular meshwork pigmented, scleral spur white and ciliary body band grey brown, memorised as orientation ladder. Deepest visible structure grades openness in Shaffer system next lesson. **Scleral spur** remains anchor landmark separating meshwork from ciliary band in orientation.
steps.say: Structure ladder together gives gonioscopy orientation at slit lamp during angle assessment in glaucoma clinics for adults. Spur gives anchor value additionally. Deepest structure gives grading input.

steps.tx: Use this view as the orientation ladder in real time. The **scleral spur** is the pale anchor band: everything in front of it belongs to the drainage angle you must grade, and everything behind it is ciliary body. Schwalbe line marks the far edge, pigmented meshwork does the filtering, and the spur keeps you oriented when pigment is heavy. Naming the bands aloud in order prevents the common error of lasering or grading the wrong structure.
steps.say: Name angle bands in order from Schwalbe line to ciliary body, using the pale scleral spur as anchor. That ladder grades openness and prevents treating the wrong structure.

vis.caption: Angle structures are labelled in sequence from Schwalbe line through meshwork and scleral spur to ciliary body band. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: **Indentation gonioscopy** presses cornea to push aqueous into angle separating appositional contact that opens from synechial adhesion that stays closed in angle closure assessment. This dynamic manoeuvre decides iridotomy versus synechial chronicity management. Static grade without indentation therefore underdiagnoses closure mechanism completeness.
steps.say: Dynamic pressing together gives apposition separation in angle closure at gonioscopy clinics for acute and chronic cases. Static grade gives incompleteness additionally. Manoeuvre gives iridotomy logic.

steps.tx: Angle recession after blunt trauma widens ciliary band by ciliary body tear, glaucoma risk lifelong in injured eye needing annual pressure surveillance. Pigment dispersion and pseudoexfoliation deposit patterns give secondary open angle clues on meshwork and lens from capsule lessons. **Secondary signs** therefore read during same gonioscopy that grades openness.
steps.say: Secondary signs together give cause reading during gonioscopy in glaucoma assessment at trauma follow up clinics. Recession gives lifelong surveillance additionally. Deposits give pattern value.

steps.tx: Grades only mean something when both ends of the scale are visible together. A **Shaffer grade 4** angle opens at about forty five degrees with ciliary body clearly seen, while grade 0 shows no structures at all because iris touches cornea. Between them, each lost band raises the risk of closure. Recording the grade in every quadrant, rather than a single average, is what makes the next clinician trust your assessment.
steps.say: Shaffer grading runs from grade 4 wide open to grade 0 closed, band by band. Record every quadrant rather than one average so the assessment stays trustworthy.

vis.caption: A wide open grade 4 angle is contrasted with a closed grade 0 angle in Shaffer gonioscopy grading. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: **Neovascular angle** vessels crossing scleral spur into meshwork signal ischaemic drive from diabetes or vein occlusion toward neovascular glaucoma emergency in secondary batch. Finding angle vessels therefore triggers retinal ischaemia hunt same visit. Gonioscopy in diabetic eye disease therefore is pressure prevention, not formality.
steps.say: Angle vessels together give ischaemia hunt trigger in diabetic gonioscopy at glaucoma clinics for adults with retinopathy. Retinal drive gives cause direction additionally. Prevention gives examination value.

steps.tx: Blood in Schlemm canal from raised episcleral venous pressure in fistula lesson returns as gonioscopic venous sign, angle otherwise open. Plateau iris configuration flat plane with steep closure on indentation imaging by ultrasound biomicroscopy where gonioscopy ambiguous. **Imaging adjuncts** therefore resolve mechanism where mirror view equivocal.
steps.say: Imaging adjuncts together give mechanism resolution where gonioscopy equivocal in angle closure at tertiary clinics for difficult cases. Canal blood gives venous clue additionally. Plateau gives configuration value.

steps.tx: Paediatric gonioscopy under anaesthesia in congenital glaucoma finds trabeculodysgenesis and Barkan membrane concepts guiding goniotomy approach. Adult technique awake therefore adapts to infant theatre assessment in congenital lists. **Age adaptation** keeps gonioscopy mandatory across lifespan glaucoma. Adult gonioscopy findings therefore translate directly into infant theatre planning where congenital disease is suspected.
steps.say: Age adaptation together gives gonioscopy continuity in congenital glaucoma at theatre assessment for infants with buphthalmos. Membrane concepts give goniotomy direction additionally. Mandatory status gives lifespan value.

steps.tx: Anchors: mirror overcomes reflection, spur anchors ladder, indentation splits apposition and secondary signs share sitting. Angle vessels hunt retina, recession surveils lifelong. **Deepest structure seen** is gonioscopy data sentence in every glaucoma record, not open or closed shorthand alone. Training therefore signs off gonioscopy competence before independent glaucoma clinics in modern programmes.
steps.say: Deepest structure together gives gonioscopy data quality in glaucoma records at diagnosis clinics for adults reliably each time. Indentation gives mechanism additionally. Secondary gives cause completion.
